chapters.title: Email authentication: SPF, DKIM and DMARC

topics.title: SPF records and all mechanisms (-all, ~all)
paraphrases: How an SPF TXT record lists authorized senders and how its all qualifiers decide what happens to unlisted senders.

concepts.learning_objective: How an SPF TXT record lists authorized senders and how its all qualifiers decide what happens to unlisted senders.

topics.title: DKIM signatures and selectors
paraphrases: How DKIM signs messages to prove integrity, where the selector public key lives in DNS, and how to find the signature header.

concepts.learning_objective: How DKIM signs messages to prove integrity, where the selector public key lives in DNS, and how to find the signature header.

topics.title: DMARC policies and alignment
paraphrases: What the DMARC none, quarantine and reject policies do and how alignment ties SPF and DKIM results to the From domain.

concepts.learning_objective: What the DMARC none, quarantine and reject policies do and how alignment ties SPF and DKIM results to the From domain.

topics.title: Email gateway filtering, spam scoring and attachment sandboxing
paraphrases: How an email security gateway scores spam, analyzes message content and detonates attachments in a sandbox.

concepts.learning_objective: How an email security gateway scores spam, analyzes message content and detonates attachments in a sandbox.

topics.title: Phishing indicators and lookalike domains
paraphrases: Recognizing phishing emails by signs such as urgent requests and domains that imitate legitimate ones.

concepts.learning_objective: Recognizing phishing emails by signs such as urgent requests and domains that imitate legitimate ones.

topics.title: DNSSEC records and chain of trust (RRSIG, DS)
paraphrases: How DNSSEC authenticates DNS answers with RRSIG signatures and DS records that link child zones to parents, and how to query it.

concepts.learning_objective: How DNSSEC authenticates DNS answers with RRSIG signatures and DS records that link child zones to parents, and how to query it.

topics.title: Encrypted DNS: DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS
paraphrases: How DoH and DoT encrypt DNS queries and responses and which ports they use.

concepts.learning_objective: How DoH and DoT encrypt DNS queries and responses and which ports they use.

topics.title: DNS tunneling detection
paraphrases: Spotting data hidden in DNS traffic through long subdomains and high-entropy query names.

concepts.learning_objective: Spotting data hidden in DNS traffic through long subdomains and high-entropy query names.

topics.title: DNS sinkholing of malicious domains
paraphrases: Using a DNS sinkhole to answer queries for malicious domains with a safe address.

concepts.learning_objective: Using a DNS sinkhole to answer queries for malicious domains with a safe address.
